caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a curving frame. The frame is brown and features a decorative top rail with carved details and a horizontal crossbar near the base for support. The backrest and seat of the chair are upholstered with fabric displaying an intricate diamond-shaped geometric pattern in various colors including black, pink, yellow, blue, and green. The upholstery appears textured and contrasts with the smooth wood. The chair is shown against a plain, light beige background, and the shadow under the chair indicates the light source is coming from the left side.
title: Folding Oak Chair
